result_summary: Centering carries the E01-H3 anisotropy gain and the SVD projection carries none of it. On the 11-summary ibm fixture re-encoded with the shipped OpenVINO INT8 encoder (baseline reproduced at margin +4.71 pts against the registered +4.58, V 0/24), mean-centering plus re-L2-normalization alone reaches margin +19.95 pts, a gain of +15.24 pts or 103.7 percent of the full composition's +14.71 (109.7 percent of the registered +13.90), at DR 0.2712 (3.11x baseline) and V 0/24, while the clean projection isolate (center, remove PC1, restore the mean, renormalize) reaches +4.04 pts, a recovery of -4.5 percent, at DR 0.0588. The misattribution is explained by cos(uncentered PC1, mean direction) = 0.999999 with the first uncentered singular value 9.44 against 1.51 for the second: removing the top component of an uncentered matrix is the centering. Exactly one arm clears the 60 percent bar at V 0/24 with the metric property intact, so the attribution stands and the SVD in the shipped all_but_the_top(k=1) is apparatus riding on the centering.
caveats: One fixture, one anchor, k=1 only: 11 documents and 98 statements, so the attribution is about this corpus's geometry and a corpus whose centered PC1 carried more tier signal could score arm b differently. adv2-a segments into a single statement, so its distance is a one-point cloud. The registered rows came from a torch bf16 GPU encoder and this run re-encodes with the shipped OpenVINO INT8 CPU encoder, so the sanity check is a 10% tolerance match declared by the executor before the run, not a registered tolerance and not a bit-identical reproduction; under a 5% band the required baseline row still passes at 2.80% and only the optional full-composition row falls outside at 5.06%. The registered margin band [+12, +18] did not hold: centering recovers slightly more than the whole composition's gain, so Confirmed rests on the acceptance bar and the prediction's direction and DR clauses, not on the point band. Centering pushes two adversarial distances past sqrt(2), where the shipped closeness() clips to 0; the margin is unaffected because the margin-setting adversary stays below the ceiling in every arm, and the same saturation is inherited from the shipped E01-H3 composition, but the module comment at distance.py:22 that assumes non-negative cosines stops holding after centering. The transform-cost panel is indicative only: the CPU is shared with concurrent campaign executors and the SVD-to-centering ratio moves between runs. Dropping the SVD from the shipped lever and correcting the docstring's mechanism claim is a follow-up decision, not taken here.
